keyword: how many oscars does sean penn have
claims: As of March 15, 2026, Sean Penn has won three Academy Awards.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor for One Battle After Another (2025) at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sean Penn won Best Actor for Mystic River (2004).
Sean Penn won Best Actor for Milk (2009).
Sean Penn has received a total of six Academy Award nominations throughout his career.
